title: Funny Christmas Cocktail Clipart Bundle
author: KIDS ZONE
description:
Funny Christmas Cocktail Clipart Bundle – High-Resolution Digital Clipart Bundle
Add spirited holiday humor to your designs with this hilarious Christmas cocktail watercolor collection. Featuring cocktail glasses filled with ruby-red drinks, sugared rims, cranberries, and candy canes, humorously occupied by Santa Claus lounging or sleeping in martini glasses, gingerbread men floating in festive goblets, reindeer in cocktail bowls, and tiny fairies perching on champagne flutes.
🎨 What’s Included:
* 19 Individual High-Quality PNG Images
* Transparent Backgrounds
* 300 DPI High Resolution for Crisp, Clear Printing
* Approximately 15″ x 18″ (4500 x 5400 px) Canvas Size
* Instant Digital Download
✨ Perfect For:
Holiday cocktail party invitations, funny bartender t-shirts, festive bar cart decor, Christmas cocktail menus, humorous drink coasters, holiday party banners, tumbler wraps, and sublimation crafts.
⚠️ Please Note:
* This is a digital download; no physical product will be shipped.
* Colors may vary slightly depending on your monitor and printer settings.
* Preview images and mockups are for presentation purposes only.
